content.title: Why Calavo (CVGW) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of fresh produce company Calavo Growers (NASDAQ:CVGW) jumped 12.2% in the afternoon session after the company agreed to be acquired by avocado producer Mission Produce (AVO) in a cash-and-stock deal.

content.title: Why Mission Produce (AVO) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of avocado company Mission Produce (NASDAQ:AVO) fell 5.4% in the afternoon session after the company agreed to acquire Calavo Growers (CVGW) in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at approximately $430 million.

content.title: Mission Produce plucks avocado rival Calavo Growers
content.summary: “This acquisition marks an important milestone for Mission and for our industry,” Mission Produce co-founder Steve Barnard said.

content.title: Mission Produce buys avocado rival Calavo in deal worth $430M
content.summary: The acquisition gives the produce giant a path to enter the ready-made guacamole market and expand its portfolio to include tomatoes and papayas.

content.title: Calavo: Fiscal Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: The Santa Paula, California-based company said it had profit of 21 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, came to 25 cents per share. The avocado grower posted revenue of $124.7 million in the period.

content.title: Mission Produce to Acquire Rival Avocado Producer Calavo in $483 Million Deal
content.summary: Mission Produce  has agreed to acquire  Calavo Growers  combining two of the most prominent publicly traded avocado producers.  Calavo stockholders will receive $27 a share as part of the deal, comprising $14.85 in cash and about 0.98 of a share of Mission’s stock for each Calavo share, the companies said Wednesday.  The deal will create more sourcing security and help Mission—one the biggest publicly traded avocado producers in the U.S.—to expand its presence in North America, Mission said.

content.title: Calavo (NASDAQ:CVGW) Misses Q3 CY2025 Revenue Estimates, But Stock Soars 13.4%
content.summary: Fresh produce company Calavo Growers (NASDAQ:CVGW) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 26.6% year on year to $124.7 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.25 per share was 32.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Stock surged from Mission Produce's acquisition announcement.

content.title: 3 Russell 2000 Stocks Walking a Fine Line
content.summary: The Russell 2000 (^RUT) is packed with potential breakout stocks, thanks to its focus on smaller companies with high growth potential. However, smaller size also means these businesses often lack the resilience and financial flexibility of large-cap firms, making careful selection crucial.
